items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The bosses were Mal Frazier and Johnny Carey... I saw him for quite a few years out there

ctx.x: An after-hour club. It wasn't exactly an after-hours spot. It didn't have a license. The bosses were Mal Frazier and Johnny Carey, and they were all, um, sweetie-pies... Because all they did was, a whole lot of women came through there. It must have been an assignation joint, where you send out chicks to hustle. Because they had these all these glamour, supposedly glamour women coming to...
